newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's govt to review interest rates - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's govt to review interest rates - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) meets today to set the Basic Interest Rate of the Central Bank (TBC) and the Rate of Assistance of the Central Bank (TBAN) for October, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.
The TBC and the TBAN are used as reference rates for Central Bank's rediscount lines and, in theory, indicate the floor and ceiling of domestic interest rates, the newspaper said.

Finance Ministry and Central Bank officials are convinced that there are internal and external limits to a deep reduction in interest rates, despite pressure from some economic sectors for a rate cut following lower inflation in August and September, it said.
Gazeta said preliminary studies point to a drop in the TBC to between 1.82 percent and 1.86 percent a month in October, compared with September's 1.88 percent.
Market analysts bet on a TBC rate at 1.83 percent, it added.
